title: Decoy
line: Give something up to lure a piece onto a square where it can be hit.

steps.text: If the black king stood in the corner, your knight could fork it and the queen from f7.
Lure the king into the corner: give up your rook there, with check.
steps.hint: The rook goes all the way up its file.
steps.after: The king had to take the rook.

steps.text: Now the fork: check the king and attack the queen.
steps.after: The king steps away, and the queen is left.
A rook and a knight for the queen: White is ahead.

summary: Give something up to drag a piece onto a bad square, then hit it there, often with a fork.
